versions.changelog:
- Added a skill metadata header with name, version, description, author, and environment variable requirements.
- Linked API key registration more prominently in the setup section.
- No changes to feature logic, API usage, or output format.
- This update focuses on improved documentation structure and integration metadata.

Initial release of Insider Trade Tracker.

- Monitors SEC-reported insider buying and selling using the Finskills API.
- Detects and summarizes unusual insider transactions, cluster buy/sell signals, and officer trading.
- Provides a clear analysis workflow: filters transactions, weights by insider role, detects clusters, and summarizes net sentiment.
- Outputs concise, investor-friendly insider trade reports with context and caution flags.
- Requires a (free) Finskills API key for all functionality.
